subject: auto_test: error when test file changes?

messages.author: e531efa2753b204e
messages.subject: auto_test: error when test file changes?
parts:
I'm just trying to get started with writing a minimal package with devtools and testthat. I started trying to use auto_test, but whenever I change a test file, I get an error.

I start creating a package like so:

> dev_mode()
> package.skeleton("encabulatr")

> edit(file="encabulatr/R/encabulatr.r")
#then type into encabulatr.r:

turbo.encabulate <- function(...) {
  stop("fill me out!")
}

#then: 
d> dir.create("encabulatr/inst")
d> dir.create("encabulatr/inst/tests")
> edit(file="encabulatr/inst/tests/test_encabulate.r")

# I type in my first unit test:

require(encabulatr)
require(testthat

test_that("encabulation of 0 or 1 elements is idempotent", {
    expect_that(turbo.encabulate(c()), equals(c()))
    expect_that(turbo.encabulate(4), equals(4))
    expect_that(turbo.encabulate(NA), equals(NA))
})

#Okay then.

> load_all("encabulatr")
> test("encabulatr")

# This produces the expected error. So far so good?

Now I want to try using auto_test, so I fire up a second R process and go:

> auto_test("encabulatr/R", "encabulatr/inst/tests")

Then I fix the code to pass the test case, and that is automatically detected and re-run. Then I go to write a second test case. 

When I write a changed test_encabulate.r to disk, I get:

Changed code:  encabulatr.r 
Rerunning all tests
...
Rerunning tests:  test_encabulate.r 
Error in envRefInferField(x, what, getClass(class(x)), selfEnv) : 
  "new" is not a valid field or method name for reference class "SummaryReporter"

This error repeats with every changed file until I kill auto_test and restart it.

What am I missing?

Peter

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: auto_test: error when test file changes?
parts:
Hi Peter,

Thanks for the bug report - it's now fixed in the dev version, which
you can get with devtools::install_github("test_that")

Hadley
